A Canadian perspective on the best steak
Oct 2026 • Couples
First thing I’m gonna say is I’m from halfway around the world from Canada near Toronto
So Vietnam is a very foreign place to me
I was overwhelmed with its beautiful culture and people 
Having said that I saw on Google Maps this restaurant that is very close to my hotel the Rex 
When I looked into it, I found they had Wagyu steaks
We don’t get that kind of stuff in Canada
So I messaged the owner and made sure I was able to find the restaurant
Things are very different here and the big establishments are well marked, but the small ones are not
I was met by a lovely waitress and seated at their best table
And I have to tell you it was absolutely the best steak I’ve ever had in my life
It was like butter in my mouth
And the house salad was completely over the top once again the best house salad I’ve ever had
Not just a bunch of lettuce with oil on top of it
There was tropical fruits and cherry tomatoes, and all kinds of things in it
Yes, you have to get over the entrance in the staircase to come up top
But once you’re here it’s small it’s quaint, but the food is well worth it
Please take it from someone that comes from a completely different world that this is an awesome place to eat
